name: generated_stories_detection_v1
runtime_policy: Pin actual installed Ollama at preparation; allow documented runtime revision from historical 0.40.0, never a model/prompt/config substitution.
failure_policy: Null predictions for terminal inference failures, output-limit termination and invalid explicit decisions; retain all scheduled records. No quality retries. Existing bounded journal retry policy: four starts maximum per story/condition.
parser_policy: Preserve original parser output for audit; use existing explicit_decision_v1 corrected main100 parser for primary labels so malformed decisions never become default classes.
duplicate_policy: Report exact-text groups; block identical versions within an accepted pair or conflicting gold labels on identical text. Retain other duplicates with original prompt-family grouping; never silently deduplicate.
